title: Sonderr Architecture Ratchet Allowlist
description: Baseline exception list for Sonderr-owned domain architecture boundaries and state ratchets. Upstream-owned shared sonderr files are exempt to prevent upstream merge conflicts. As Sonderr legacy sites are refactored into clean Effect layers, decrement counts or remove entries to lock in progress.

sonderr-instance-state-singletons.description: Legacy InstanceState.make usages in Sonderr-owned code (packages/cli/src/sonderr/**, packages/cli/src/sonderr-*/**). Target: encapsulate in scoped Effect Services in packages/core.

sonderr-database-constructors.description: Direct new Database() / new DatabaseSync() instantiations in Sonderr-owned code. Target: all persistence routes through core Database.Service.

sonderr-tool-process-env.description: Direct process.env reads in Sonderr-owned tools. Target: pass configuration explicitly via Tool.Context or Env.Service.
